meta.title: Lesson 26: Use an API Carefully
meta.title_zh: 第 26 课：谨慎使用 API

study_card.main_practice: 跟读 + 精读 + 中文讲解对照
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 再听读 · 最后完成英文输出

segments.en: My small program calls an API. An API is a door to another service. I send a request and receive a response. The response has data and a status code. I print the status before I trust the data.
segments.tts: My small program calls an API. An API is a door to another service. I send a request and receive a response. The response has data and a status code. I print the status before I trust the data.
segments.zh: 我的小程序调用一个 API。API 是通往另一个服务的一扇门。我发送请求并收到响应。响应有数据和状态码。我在相信数据前先打印状态。讲解：API=程序接口，request=请求，response=响应，status code=状态码。

segments.en: The request fails when the key is missing. I keep the key outside the code. A secret should not appear in a public file or a screenshot. I use an environment variable instead.
segments.tts: The request fails when the key is missing. I keep the key outside the code. A secret should not appear in a public file or a screenshot. I use an environment variable instead.
segments.zh: 当 key 缺失时，请求失败。我把 key 放在代码外。秘密不应该出现在公开文件或截图里，我改用环境变量。讲解：secret=秘密，public=公开的，screenshot=截图，environment variable=环境变量。

segments.en: I also set a limit on requests. A free service may have a small quota. If I call it too often, the program may stop. Good code handles the limit and tells the user what happened.
segments.tts: I also set a limit on requests. A free service may have a small quota. If I call it too often, the program may stop. Good code handles the limit and tells the user what happened.
segments.zh: 我还给请求设置限制。免费服务可能只有很小的配额。如果调用太频繁，程序可能停止。好的代码会处理限制，并告诉用户发生了什么。讲解：quota=配额，often=经常地，handle=处理，happen=发生。
